authoringRule: Start with story and visual-world planning, then use the full Director View. Filter ordinary creative choices to recommendationStatus=RECOMMENDABLE, inspect exact pixels, perform film preflight, then validate JSON against the exact CURRENT contract.
recommendationRule: Use recommendationStatus=RECOMMENDABLE for normal creative authoring. PIXEL_COMPLETION_REQUIRED and DO_NOT_RECOMMEND_PENDING_SOURCE_REVIEW remain evidence/engineering states and must not be selected as ordinary principal assets.
completionQueueRule: The Director completion queue and eligibility audit are Unity engineering work data. Debora/the designer must never be asked to repair them, locate their source files, annotate their entries or upload their missing previews.
filmPreflightRule: Before final JSON verify story coherence, variable dramatic shot rhythm, location continuity, real pixel inspection, recommendation state, style/perspective compatibility, role capability/runtime form, system-managed scale=1 by default, Unity-owned background Cover, semantic depth, visible portrait dialogue, line-specific dialogue composition, audio pass and meaningful VFX intent.
visualRule: The single CURRENT Visual Atlas PDF is the preferred pixel source. Never infer appearance from names or metadata. Binary/Base64 access without pixel rendering is not visual inspection.
visualAccessFallbackRule: If ChatGPT cannot actually render and inspect the public Atlas URL, it must stop visual asset selection and ask the user to download and upload exactly one file from the Debora page: STARWARS_DELTA_CHATGPT_VISUAL_ATLAS_CURRENT.pdf. Continue with the same CURRENT metadata after upload.
ordinaryUserDownloadRule: No download is normally required. For ordinary visual-access fallback, request only the single CURRENT Visual Atlas PDF. Do not ask for Catalog ZIPs, Instruction Book ZIPs, the 300MB Visual Library, four category PDFs or engineering completion artifacts.
atomicRule: Verify publishTransactionId, catalogRevision, snapshotContentHash, contractRevision and schemaHash as one atomic identity before authoring.
migrationRule: Old JSON is migration/failure evidence only. New JSON must use the exact current schema/context/contract/catalog identity. The importer must migrate deterministically or reject precisely; it must not silently resolve stale IDs to unrelated visuals.
eligibilityRule: A missing preview does not prove a missing film asset. The completion queue separates deterministic preview generation from source eligibility/classification review; flagged sample, generated or technical-looking records are not normal recommendations.
roleRule: RECOMMENDABLE does not imply valid for every cast role. Verify required Director capability, authoringRuntimeForm and inspected narrative appearance before assigning a principal role; principal diagnostic fallback is not representative success.
proportionRule: For systemManagedProportions actors, authored scale defaults to 1.0 and is only a small deliberate multiplier. Never compensate for source pixel dimensions in JSON.
continuityRule: Prefer same-world style, perspective, lighting and location continuity over literal filename/displayName matches.
backgroundRule: Background/FarBackground composition is authored semantically; Unity owns Cover. A location plate appearing as a small rectangle with black margins is a RED preview failure.
depthRule: Plan semantic depth for backgrounds, distant/principal actors, effects, foreground and UI. Nested Prefab sorting is not cinematic intent, and accidental principal occlusion is a RED preview failure.
dialogueRule: Portrait presets must visibly materialize required portraits. Dialogue-only participants use DialoguePortrait presentation; locked line changes use cut-based TWO_SHOT/SPEAKER_FOCUS/reaction composition and supported NEAR/MID/FAR semantics.
animationRule: Use exact AnimationClip IDs compatible with the selected recommendable canonical Actor. One representative image per animation family is intentional; actor appearance alone is not proof of motion content.
audioRule: Audio is a first-class non-visual Director input. Narrative cutscenes require an audio pass when suitable CURRENT audio exists, and audio must not be counted as a visual gap.
vfxRule: Effects require timing, dramatic purpose, semantic depth, readable occupancy and target/anchor when supported. A random explosion overlay is not a directed cinematic event.
cameraRule: Prefer semantic camera purpose/composition and the V3 Cinematic Camera Director path where available instead of raw camera-number micromanagement.
prefabRule: Prefab internals are not authoring vocabulary. Only safe CanonicalActor or PreviewSafeVisualComposite projections may be selected; gameplay scripts, colliders and physics remain hidden.
deboraRule: Debora opens deboraPageUrl, presses COPY FOR CHAT, pastes the message, and describes the cutscene. If ChatGPT cannot render the Atlas from the web, Debora uses the page's DOWNLOAD VISUAL ATLAS PDF button and uploads that single PDF to the chat. Debora never manages the completion queue.
fallbackRule: Use fallbackDirectorPackUrl only when direct Pages access to CURRENT metadata genuinely fails. Never use the Director ZIP merely because Atlas pixel rendering failed, and never mix transactions or manually pair older packages.
